source: Historical C4 demonstrations, 19-20 October 2026; existing accepted pixels copied unchanged.
privacy: Only previously hash-accepted cropped/redacted playback files. No raw recordings, account snapshots, logs or private inventories.

assets.caption: One continuous Validation Release recording: All to General to All; TOP to SIDE; select a neutral topic; BOTTOM to SIDE; return to All and TOP.
assets.limits: Group identity, one unapproved neutral label and service-history area are redacted. The bottom topic panel is unobscured between 16 and 18 seconds. Only synthetic emoji media and approved topic labels are visible. No message is sent and no server topic settings are changed. This demonstrates controls and preserved selection, not frame-time performance or long-list pagination.

assets.caption: One continuous Validation Release recording: an isolated three-chat folder to a forum topic list and rail; open a full-width topic; Back; switch to another prepared group via its rail icon; Back to the same folder.
assets.limits: Private chat-row text, group headers, older topic rows and message content are redacted with opaque rectangles, including explicit time intervals for chat-list states and the Back transition. The composer, full-width conversation boundary, approved neutral topic rows and three permitted QA icons remain visible outside privacy intervals. Three rail items need no scrolling; this is not long-rail, pagination, message-content or performance evidence.

assets.caption: Unsaved topic editor: color selection and animated icon preview.
assets.limits: The lower icon grid is outside the crop; choosing an icon is visible as the preview changes. No topic was created or edited on the server. Status/navigation bars are excluded. Actual installed Validation Release; after-only.

assets.caption: Topic-icon search: clear the first query, enter another, and clear it again.
assets.limits: A cropped search component, not a full-screen editor or server-operation test. Keyboard suggestions and account/system UI are outside the crop. Actual installed Validation Release; after-only.

assets.caption: Multi-topic selection toolbar: one selected topic, two, then one again.
assets.limits: Only the toolbar is shown; the topic rows and private chat rail are outside the crop. No action was applied to a topic. This is not a complete selection-list or permission-matrix demonstration. Actual installed Validation Release; after-only.

assets.caption: Topic notification controls: open the group-default / silent sound choices, then cancel.
assets.limits: Topic identity and system UI are outside the crop. Settings are not changed; this clip does not test delivery or sound playback. Actual installed Validation Release; after-only.

assets.caption: Topic profile overview: action row, visible link field, and empty shared-content state. Topic/group names and link text are redacted.
assets.limits: Static overview recording, not an action execution or materials-filter demonstration. Opaque rectangles hide actual identifiers; no replacement UI is drawn. Actual installed Validation Release; after-only.

assets.caption: Topic list with individual icons, service-message previews and right-aligned pinned, closed, muted and read status. Select two rows, deselect one, then cancel selection.
assets.limits: Shows the first six rows, not the entire group or header/rail. The user explicitly allowed the neutral Topic 1-5 and General labels and the generic You: Topic updated / You: Changed the group photo service previews. Group identifiers, neighboring chats and lower QA rows are outside the crop. No bulk action was applied. Actual installed Validation Release; after-only.

assets.caption: Unsaved New Topic editor: visible form, color selection, built-in icon grid, and updating icon preview.
assets.limits: System status and navigation bars are cropped away. Design notes is unsaved demonstration input. The keyboard is closed and no topic is created. This does not demonstrate saving, server state, or the edit-existing lifecycle. Actual installed Validation Release; after-only.

assets.caption: After: opening a forum from an isolated three-chat folder and returning; the real chat rail enters with the topic pane.
assets.limits: Upper-screen crop. Group headers and three outgoing chat-text bands are opaque for privacy; these bands also obscure part of the topic list. Three generic rail icons and neutral Topic 1–5 / General labels are approved. No rail scrolling, full-message content, before state or frame-time claim.

assets.caption: After: opening a topic hides the rail and uses the full viewport width; Back restores the list and rail.
assets.limits: Upper-screen crop, private header text masked. Message history and older QA rows are outside the crop. This shows viewport geometry, not the full message composer or a performance benchmark. Before recording pending.

assets.caption: After: top topic selector, switching Topic 5 → Topic 4 → Topic 3 → Topic 5.
assets.limits: System bars removed; group subtitle and service-message area opaque. Native UI, no replacement of messages or controls. No All/General media or before state in this clip.

assets.caption: After: side topic selector, switching Topic 5 → Topic 4 → Topic 3 → Topic 5.
assets.limits: System bars removed; group subtitle, one unapproved topic label and service-message area opaque. The side panel and placement control remain visible. No before state or scrolling claim.

assets.caption: After: bottom topic selector, switching Topic 5 → Topic 4 → Topic 3 → Topic 5.
assets.limits: System bars removed; group subtitle and service-message area opaque. Native UI geometry and playback timing retained. No before state in this clip.

assets.caption: Before: stock upstream Release opens the prepared forum as a flat message history and returns to the isolated three-chat folder. There is no topic list or chat rail.
assets.limits: System bars removed. Header and the entire upper history/outgoing chat-text band are opaque across the full transition path; lower neutral service rows and composer remain visible. Reused as the available stock navigation reference for both rail entry and topic transition, not an identical topic-opening action: stock has no such screen. No rail scrolling or frame-time claim. Full-height crop differs from the upper crops of the paired After clips; hidden regions are not design evidence.

assets.caption: Before: actual stock upstream view of the prepared tabs-mode group, with ordinary message history and composer but no topic selector.
assets.limits: One stationary eight-second recording reused explicitly for top, side and bottom After variants; not three separate baseline functions or a recording of placement changes. System bars, group title/member line and a clipped earlier message line are excluded. Only neutral synthetic emoji media remains. No input, message sending, performance or notification evidence.

assets.caption: Validation: one chat-list row with recent-topic icons and labels, including the temporary neutral topic.
assets.limits: Single-row crop; all neighboring chats excluded. Group name, older QA-topic label and existing draft text are redacted. The draft is preserved, so the footer differs from the stock last-message preview. This does not demonstrate the hidden draft text.

assets.caption: Validation: a stationary view of the incoming synthetic image and long caption, with the avatar beside the author name.
assets.limits: Author name and avatar pixels are redacted in their real positions. The crop excludes the header and composer. Same message and horizontal scale as Before; no frame-time or performance comparison.

assets.caption: Validation: topic profile, Files, Media and Links containing only the authorized synthetic fixtures.
assets.limits: The group name and topic URL are redacted. This is one topic, not group-wide shared materials; no server settings are changed during capture.

assets.caption: Stock upstream: the same chat-list row, showing the sender and synthetic last-message preview without a topic strip.
assets.limits: Single-row crop; all neighboring chats excluded and group name redacted. Existing selected All-tab taps outside the crop keep the recorder active; the visible row stays stationary. The approved neutral icon and synthetic example.com text remain. Stock shows a last-message preview, whereas Validation retains an existing topic draft.

assets.caption: Stock upstream: a stationary view of the same incoming synthetic image and long caption, with the avatar at the side of the message.
assets.limits: Author identity and the service rows above the message are redacted. The crop excludes the header and composer. Same message and horizontal scale as After; vertical message origins differ.

assets.caption: Stock upstream: group profile with Links and Docs filters showing the same synthetic link and document.
assets.limits: Stock has no equivalent topic profile. Group identity and an older unrelated document are redacted. The media filter is not opened; its unrelated contents are outside this demonstration.
